rows.title: Arrival details wording: labels, hints, placeholder and means of transport options, in animals and plants
rows.detail: Bring the arrival details page's visible copy up to Design Release 2.1: medium-size question labels, the new port of entry hint and placeholder, the shorter means of transport options and the shorter transport identification lead-in. The 9 October afternoon ruling has the same increment move plants' arrival details labels to medium size and give its place of landing hint the same pattern, while plants keeps its own questions and data. What the pages submit and store does not change: means of transport is still stored as its code, because the backend and other services read it (c-047). The animals page stays at its 'port-of-entry' address.
acceptanceCriteria: Each of the five question labels on arrival details (arrival date, port of entry, means of transport, transport identification, transport document reference) is set in the GOV.UK medium label size rather than the small bold size (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-028; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p10-006, trace-e2e-p4-064; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p16-013)

The port of entry hint reads 'Select where the transporter will enter with the consignment. Start typing to search by port or airport name or code.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-025; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-076; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-012; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-010)

The port of entry search shows the placeholder 'Select a port' when no port is chosen (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-026; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-013; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-010)

The means of transport options read 'Air', 'Rail', 'Road' and 'Sea', in that order (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-036; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-077; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-023)

Choosing 'Air', 'Rail', 'Road' or 'Sea' still stores the means of transport as AIRPLANE, RAILWAY, ROAD_VEHICLE or VESSEL in the saved notification, and Rail or Road still leads to transit countries (conflict c-047; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-036, repo-frontend-p11-054)
The transport identification hint's lead-in reads 'Enter one of the following:' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-043; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-025)

In the plants frontend, every question label on arrival details (the arrival date in each of its three wordings, 'Expected time of arrival' and 'Proposed place of landing') is set in the GOV.UK medium label size (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-034; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p5-089, repo-plantsfrontend-p5-090, repo-plantsfrontend-p5-091, repo-plantsfrontend-p5-100, repo-plantsfrontend-p5-103)

In the plants frontend, the place of landing hint reads 'Select where the potatoes will enter Great Britain. Start typing to search by port or airport name or code.' (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-034; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p5-103; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-025)
notes: Combines the copy slices for one page (req-278 labels, req-293 hint, req-294 placeholder, req-309 to req-312 means of transport options, req-318 lead-in) with plants' mirror of the labels and hint (req-1931, req-1930): same page, same copy and the same review, and the 9 October afternoon ruling (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-034) puts plants in this same increment. The four option relabels are one criterion because the reviewer checks them together; the stored code is its own criterion (c-047).

The hint and placeholder follow the prototype within the accessible-autocomplete the real frontend already uses (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-010). The page stays at 'port-of-entry' (req-1807), and the k6 script keeps working because field names and codes do not change (req-1808).

Re-distil: citations rewritten to the current ruling claim ids; the earlier row cited ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-026, p1-028 and p3-022, which now say other things. The transport copy file is shared with the transporters area.

rows.title: Port options read '<port name> - <port code>', in animals and plants
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 shows each port as its name, a dash and its code. The 9 October afternoon ruling builds the label now, in the animals port of entry search and the plants place of landing search in the same increment, within the accessible-autocomplete the real frontends already use. The real service keeps submitting and storing the port code (c-047) and keeps a native select underneath that works without JavaScript (c-006). The search button waits on design in its own row, and bold matches are not copied (req-299, out of scope).
acceptanceCriteria: Each port of entry option reads '<port name> - <port code>', for example 'Port of Dover - GB DVR', with and without JavaScript (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-028; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-014; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-010, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-017)
With JavaScript, once a port is chosen the search box shows it as '<port name> - <port code>' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-084; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p16-050)
Choosing 'Port of Dover - GB DVR' still saves the port code GB DVR in the saved notification (conflict c-047; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-027)

In the plants frontend, each place of landing option, and with JavaScript the chosen port in the search box, reads '<port name> - <port code>', for example 'Port of Dover - GB DVR', and choosing one still saves its port code (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-035; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p5-104; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-014)
Without JavaScript, the port of entry and place of landing questions are still labelled native selects that choose and save a port (conflict c-006)
notes: Combines req-295 (animals port labels) and req-1929 (plants place of landing labels): the same port search over the same reference-data list, and ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-035 puts plants in the same increment. req-296 (the Search button) sits in its own blocked row; req-299 (bold matches) is out of scope.

The 'Port of Dover - GB DVR' example is a real, correctly spelt port in both the stub and MDM. The tests repo's port selection relies on the '(code)' text today (repo-tests-p1-095) and must follow the new option text.
Re-distil: citations rewritten to the current ruling claim ids (p1-017, p3-035) and plants claim (repo-plantsfrontend-p5-104).

rows.title: Arrival details requires a means of transport, and arrival and transit return to where the trader came from
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 makes means of transport the one required answer on arrival details, because it decides whether transit countries are asked. It also sends a trader back to where they started: the overview when they opened the page from the overview, the review when they came from the review. 'Save and return to overview' lets a trader leave a part-finished page without a means of transport. The real service keeps every field check it has today (c-045): a page with any error saves nothing and shows the entries back, and an answer that cannot be stored, such as an impossible date, is refused even on 'Save and return to overview' (c-211).
acceptanceCriteria: Save and continue on arrival details with no means of transport chosen stays on the page and shows 'Select a means of transport to the port of entry' in the error summary, linking to the means of transport select, and above the select, which is shown in its error style (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-039, prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-040; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-081; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-030, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-031)
When that error shows, the page title starts 'Error: ', nothing is saved and the other answers entered are shown back (conflict c-006; conflict c-045)

When arrival details was opened from the overview's 'Arrival details' task, Save and continue with valid answers saves them and returns to the overview (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-012, prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-053; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-196)

When transit countries was opened from the overview's 'Transit countries' task, Save and continue saves the countries and returns to the overview (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-067; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-099; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-196)

When arrival details was reached from the page before it in the journey, Save and continue still goes on to transit countries for Rail or Road and to Transporter details otherwise (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-052, repo-frontend-p11-054; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p10-028)

When arrival details was opened from a Change link on the notification review, Save and continue saves and returns to the review (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-053, prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-083)

'Save and return to overview' on arrival details with no means of transport chosen saves the other answers, raises no error and goes to the overview, where 'Arrival details' is not Complete (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-051; conflict c-211)

'Save and return to overview' on arrival details with an impossible arrival date, such as 31/2/2027, stays on the page with 'Enter a real arrival date' and saves nothing (conflict c-211; conflict c-045; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-019)

'Save and return to overview' on transit countries saves the countries listed and goes to the overview (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-080; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p17-059)
notes: Combines req-315 (means of transport required), req-327 (return to overview), req-328 (return to review) and req-329 (Save and return to overview): all four decide what Save and continue and Save and return do on the same two pages, and each criterion needs the others' set-up to observe.
Animals only: plants gets return to the overview and the lenient save from inc-002 and inc-003 (req-1934, req-1935, not this area's), not from this row.

c-045 keeps today's field checks; c-211 keeps format checks on 'Save and return to overview'. Depends on inc-002 (a page opened from its overview task returns there; ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-198 adds no address marker) and on inc-003 ('Save and return to overview' without required checks), so this row uses those mechanisms rather than building second ones.

rows.title: Transit countries page: title, Back link, empty state and redirect when it does not apply
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 names the page 'Transit countries' in the browser tab, steps Back to arrival details when the trader came from there, hides the list until a country is added, and sends anyone who opens the page when the means of transport is not overland back to the overview.
acceptanceCriteria: The transit countries page title is 'Transit countries - Import notification service - GOV.UK', and 'Error: Transit countries - Import notification service - GOV.UK' when it shows an error (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-064-m1; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-089; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-047; conflict c-006)

When transit countries was reached by Save and continue on arrival details, its Back link goes to arrival details (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-061; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-092; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-051)

When transit countries was opened from the overview's 'Transit countries' task, its Back link goes to the overview (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-061; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-095)

Opening the transit countries page when the saved means of transport is Air or Sea, or none is saved, goes to the overview (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-060; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-088; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-042)

Submitting the transit countries form when the saved means of transport is Air or Sea, or none is saved, saves no countries and goes to the overview (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-060; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-045)

With no transit countries added, the page shows no country list and no 'You have not added any countries yet.' sentence (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-073; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-055-m1)
notes: Combines the transit countries page's server-rendered changes (req-338 title, req-343 Back link, req-344 redirect, req-356 empty state): one page and one review. The 'Error: ' title prefix is kept by c-006. Transit is animals only, so plants is untouched (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-015).
The page stays at its 'transit-countries' address (req-337, req-1808). The Back link follows the same live-flow mechanism inc-002 builds, with no address marker (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-198).

rows.title: Waiting on design: transit countries added and removed in place with JavaScript, with 'Added' and 'Removed' announcements
rows.detail: With JavaScript, Design Release 2.1 adds a country as soon as it is picked, removes one without a page load and announces 'Added <country>' and 'Removed <country>'. The 9 October afternoon ruling puts all of this to design as question 4: without JavaScript the page already works with today's native select, Add country button and submitting Remove buttons, so nothing new is built now and today's announcements stay. When design answers, it is built as design says, or dropped if design drops it. The saved answer stays a list of country codes (c-047), and every server check on transit countries stays (c-045).
acceptanceCriteria: With JavaScript, choosing a country in the transit search adds it to the list straight away and clears the search box, and no 'Add country' button is shown (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-093, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p4-029; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-055, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-056)

With JavaScript, Remove takes that country off the list without a page load and leaves the other countries listed (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-072; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-095; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-058)
Adding a country announces 'Added <country>' to screen readers, for example 'Added Germany' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-055, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-072)
Adding the twelfth country announces 'Added <country>' and the 12-country limit message in the same announcement (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-096; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p17-048)
Removing a country announces 'Removed <country>' to screen readers, for example 'Removed Germany' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-058; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-095)
Each Remove control's accessible name still includes the country, such as 'Remove Germany' (conflict c-006; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-091)
Countries added and removed with JavaScript are saved by Save and continue, and the saved notification holds their country codes (conflict c-047; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-102)

Without JavaScript, the transit search is a native select with an 'Add country' button, and Remove buttons submit the page, so a country can still be added, removed and saved (conflict c-006; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-103; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-061)
With JavaScript, a thirteenth country cannot be added and a country already listed cannot be added again (conflict c-045; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-074, repo-frontend-p11-077)
openQuestions: Design answers design question 4 (transit countries) of the 9 October afternoon ruling: are adding on pick, removing without a page load and the 'Added'/'Removed' wording strongly needed, and from which tested library? Built as design says, or dropped if design drops it.
notes: Every requirement here has blockedBy design question 4 (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-061, p1-062), so the row is blocked and sits in the waiting-on-design theme (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-046), apart from rows that build now.

Combines req-348 (add on pick), req-349 (remove in place), req-353 ('Added' announcement, with the cap message) and req-354 ('Removed' announcement): one design question, one client behaviour, one page and one review. Depends on inc-029 (same page) by ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-047. Animals only: transit is never mirrored to plants.

inc-182 (germinal arrival and transit pages) lists inc-030 in its dependsOn; with inc-030 blocked, the combiner should take it out of inc-182's dependsOn, or the germinal journey waits on design for no reason.

rows.title: Arrival and transit task statuses on the overview, and transit countries on the review
rows.detail: The overview shows a task Complete only when it is. An arrival date measured from today can go stale, so a saved date more than 7 days in the past turns 'Arrival details' back to To do. 'Transit countries' is Complete only once a country is listed. The notification review lists the transit countries under Design Release 2.1's wording.
acceptanceCriteria: A notification whose saved arrival date is now more than 7 days in the past shows 'Arrival details' as To do on the overview (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-057; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-021)
A notification with Rail or Road and no transit countries saved shows 'Transit countries' as To do on the overview (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-078)

A notification with Rail or Road and at least one transit country saved shows 'Transit countries' as Complete on the overview (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-078; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p10-043)

The notification review shows the saved transit countries in a row headed 'Countries that the consignment will travel through', listing each country, with a Change link that opens the transit countries page (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-096)
notes: Combines req-332 (stale arrival date status), req-372 (transit status) and req-375 (review row): all three are how the arrival and transit answers read back elsewhere, through the section's completion rules and the review card, so they share the set-up of a saved notification. The stale-date criterion is observed with a notification whose arrival date is set up in the past through the backend, since the page refuses such a date; that is set-up for a one-page assertion, not a seeded journey.
Keeps the overview-and-review theme and its dependencies (inc-028, inc-101). Animals only: plants has no transit, and its arrival window rules are its own.
Not in the split-off type-question-and-templates theme: the review row lives in check-answers' cards, not its template-review view model.

rows.title: Port lists ordered airports, then seaports, then rail, from MDM's port type, in animals and plants
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 puts airports before seaports, and Sam's 9 October ruling builds the order now: MDM's traffic field already gives every port its type, so nothing waits on MDM. Reference data maps the type through and orders the list airports, then seaports, then rail ports in a group of their own, each group A to Z by name ignoring letter case. Today reference data sorts by name alone, case-sensitively, so airports and seaports are mixed and names in capitals sort first. The plants frontend's place of landing list follows the same order in the same increment. List content stays what MDM serves: it is never edited in code.
acceptanceCriteria: Reference data's GET /ports-of-entry returns each port's type (airport, seaport or rail), taken from MDM's traffic field, alongside its code and name (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-004, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-172, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-176; repo:referencedata repo-referencedata-p1-031, repo-referencedata-p1-032, repo-referencedata-p1-033)

Locally, in CDP dev and in CDP test, the port of entry search on arrival details lists every airport first, then every seaport, then every rail port (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-173, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-174; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-019)

Within each group, ports are listed A to Z by name ignoring letter case, so a name written in capitals sorts among the other names that start with the same letter rather than ahead of them (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-175; repo:referencedata repo-referencedata-p1-030; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p4-076)
Non-breaking and doubled spaces in a port name are compared as single spaces, so such a name sorts where the same name with single spaces would (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-175)
The ordered list still holds every port reference data returns, and choosing a port still saves its code (repo:referencedata repo-referencedata-p1-031; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-027)

In the plants frontend, the place of landing search lists the ports in the same order: airports, then seaports, then rail ports, each group A to Z by name ignoring letter case (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-029; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p5-104, repo-plantsfrontend-p9-099, repo-plantsfrontend-p9-100)
notes: Combines req-304 (the order), req-1813 (reference data returns the port type the order needs: the order cannot be observed without it) and req-1932 (plants' captured ports in the new order; ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-029 puts plants in the same increment; plants has no port of exit).

The combiner keeps this row's id and merges back the port of exit labels and order (req-1768, req-1769) and their criteria, which another area's draft carries: both lists read the same ports reference data serves, so the order is built once for entry and exit.

Depends on the stub tidy-up row (inc-173): locally and in CDP dev the type only reaches reference data once the stub serves MDM's traffic field. The frontends are listed because their captured ports fixtures must follow the new order; the order itself is reference data's. Rail sits after seaports by the ruling; Design Release 2.1 has no rail entry.

ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-177 records that Sam has not confirmed MDM's traffic field is the airport/seaport flag he asked to be checked; the ruling still builds it now (p1-172, p1-176), so the row is todo. No criterion names a particular port, so nothing pins MDM's duplicates or misspellings.

rows.title: The stub's ports match real MDM, and the animals and plants captured ports fixtures are recaptured from it
rows.detail: The ports half of the 9 October ruling's stub tidy-up. Today the stub's ports are 78 hand-kept Great Britain ports carrying only an id, a code and a name, and the stub drops any field its models do not know. After this change the stub serves MDM's real port records, whole and in MDM's order, each with its traffic, so the port type reaches reference data locally and in CDP dev as it does from real MDM. The animals frontend's and the plants frontend's captured ports fixtures are recaptured from it, so every later list row is built and tested against what MDM really serves. MDM's duplicate and misspelt ports stay: they are MDM's content, and no test pins them.
acceptanceCriteria: Locally and in CDP dev, the stub's MDM ports call answers with MDM's real port records in MDM's order, in place of the 78 hand-kept ports, each record carrying its traffic (Airport, Port or Rail), its address and its status (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-004, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-150, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-151; repo:stub repo-stub-p2-056, repo-stub-p2-057, repo-stub-p2-081)

Locally and in CDP dev, the stub serves each port record whole, including fields its own models do not name, so each port's traffic is in the response reference data reads (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-154; repo:stub repo-stub-p2-056)

Locally and in CDP dev, the ports the stub serves keep MDM's duplicate and misspelt entries and GB MID's non-breaking spaces as MDM has them, and no value MDM masks is filled in (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-151, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-153, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-163)

Locally and in CDP dev, the stub's ports call still answers as MDM does: 200 OK with the port list in its result field, needing a subscription key header whose value it does not check (repo:stub repo-stub-p2-058, repo-stub-p2-060, repo-stub-p2-061)

Locally, the port of entry search on arrival details offers the tidied stub's ports, as reference data serves them, rather than the 78 hand-kept ones (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-150; repo:referencedata repo-referencedata-p1-037)

In the animals frontend's stub mode, the port of entry search offers the same ports, in the same order, as reference data serves from the tidied stub, and no port check is marked as waiting on an endpoint that is not built (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-157, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-158; document:dr1-parity-notes document-dr1-parity-notes-p1-043)

In the plants frontend's stub mode, the place of landing search offers the same ports, in the same order, as reference data serves from the tidied stub, no port check is marked as waiting on an endpoint that is not built, and every plants check that pinned an old port name or the old count of 77 passes against the recaptured list (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-030; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p5-118, repo-plantsfrontend-p9-099-m1, repo-plantsfrontend-p9-100)
notes: The ports half of the one stub tidy-up row (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-148). The combiner keeps inc-173's id and merges back the countries half it already holds (req-1744 to req-1747, req-1750 to req-1752), the insfrontend repo and their criteria: this draft carries only this area's requirements. mdm/stub-tidy-up-spec.md is the accepted spec; where it and mdm/findings.md differ, the spec wins (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-164).

Combines req-1811 (regenerate the fixture), req-1812 (serve it whole), req-1814 (recapture the animals fixture) and req-1933 (rerun plants' capture and fix its specs; ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-030 puts plants in this same increment): the recaptures can only be observed once the stub serves the new fixture, and building them apart repeats the same stub-and-capture set-up.

The tests repo's port test data already names ports the real list holds (req-1815, exists). No test may pin a misspelt or duplicated port name. inc-007 (port order) and inc-174 (transit list) depend on this row, because it changes the names and counts their checks assert (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-149).

rows.title: Transit country search offers the GBNAG_SPS_EX countries and their subdivisions
rows.detail: Sam's 9 October ruling builds the transit country list now against reference data as MDM serves it, keeping the MDM block the list uses today. Today the transit search offers the 31-country origin list with no subdivisions. After this change it offers reference data's GBNAG_SPS_EX countries plus their subdivisions, each subdivision named with its parent country, in alphabetical order, as the country of origin page does. Where the content differs from Design Release 2.1's 41 countries, that is MDM's content to change, never a list edited in code (c-048).
acceptanceCriteria: The transit country search offers the same countries and subdivisions as the country of origin search, from reference data's GBNAG_SPS_EX block, in alphabetical order (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-138, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-145; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-066, repo-frontend-p11-067)
Each subdivision in the transit search reads '<territory> (<parent country>)', with and without JavaScript (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-139)

Adding a subdivision lists it as '<territory> (<parent country>)', Save and continue saves its code, and reopening the page lists it again under the same name (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-139; conflict c-047; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-102)
A country or subdivision that is not on the offered list is still refused with 'Select countries from the list' (conflict c-045)
notes: Its own row because it changes the transit countries page's options, code the arrival-and-transit theme owns, while the port order is reference data's.

Depends on the stub tidy-up row (inc-173), whose countries half changes the GBNAG_SPS_EX names and counts the transit tests assert. No criterion states a count, because the count differs between the stub and real MDM. The subdivision labelling already exists for the country of origin page; this row reuses it. Animals only: transit is never mirrored to plants.

rows.title: Waiting on design: a Search button beside the port of entry, transit country and place of landing searches
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 gives its type-aheads a separate Search button. The 9 October afternoon ruling makes this a mechanic beyond the accessible-autocomplete's own options, so it waits on design question 1, as one waiting-on-design increment shared with the country of origin's button. When design answers, it is built as design says, in the animals port of entry and transit country searches and the plants place of landing search, or dropped if design drops it.
acceptanceCriteria: With JavaScript, the port of entry search and the transit country search each have a search button beside the box whose accessible name is 'Search' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-026, prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-070; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-013, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-053)

In the plants frontend, with JavaScript, the place of landing search has the same search button with the accessible name 'Search' (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-024, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-036)
Without JavaScript, the three questions are still labelled native selects that choose and save an answer, with no search button (conflict c-006; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-103)
openQuestions: Design answers design question 1 (search buttons) of the 9 October afternoon ruling: is a separate Search button beside the type-ahead strongly needed, and from which tested library? Built as design says, or dropped if design drops it. No safe default: the ruling puts it to design.
notes: req-296 has blockedBy design question 1 (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-018), so it sits in a blocked row apart from the built-now port labels (inc-027), in the waiting-on-design theme (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-046).

ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-055 makes the country of origin's button (req-018, another area's) and this one ONE waiting-on-design increment: the combiner keeps inc-188's id and merges this draft with the origin area's req-018 draft and its criteria and its dependency on inc-009.
Plants is changed when the row is built (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-024, p3-036). No custom JavaScript is written to copy the prototype (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-011).
